messages:
deploy-bot: canary rollout: kernel-binner v2.1 -> 50% traffic at 03:10 UTC
Sara: heads-up — after v2.1 we see host-side p95 jump ~80ms on canary (svc=ingress-host). p50 up ~10ms. correlation with tiny gRPC writes count.
Max: looking — writev count doubled on canary hosts, lots of 80-120 byte frames.
Kev: perf top from a canary host shows ~40% CPU in tokenizer threads and ~20% in the packetizer (host-side framing).
Jordan: KV cache metrics — eviction rate x3 since the deploy, cache hit ratio down from 0.89 -> 0.73 on affected hosts.
Sara: timeline: we rolled kernel-binner config that biases narrow-kernel selection at 03:08, preparse pool shrink landed 03:05. could be interaction.
Max: my hypothesis: kernel weighting caused more small output bursts which interact poorly with packetizer microframe coalescer -> many tiny writes -> syscall overhead + scheduler churn + higher tokenization stalls.
Kev: confirmed traces: lots of syscall entry/exit in tok thread stacks. Also increased mutex contention on tokenizer pool.
Jordan: KV behavior likely secondary but amplifies: more small requests -> more mid-sized KV objects churn -> more shards hot -> evictions.
Sara: can we reproduce locally with a replay? I have a trace sampler from a canary pod.
Max: replayed 1k requests with v2.1 config -> p95 +78ms, syscall count up 2.8x, write calls up 3.1x.
Kev: quick perf diff (canary vs baseline):
```
canary: syscall rate 420/s  | tokenizer sys CPU 63% | packetizer CPU 22%
baseline: syscall rate 150/s | tokenizer sys CPU 18% | packetizer CPU 7%
```
Sara: rough root cause: small-write amplification from kernel-weight change + preparse pool reduction exposing tokenizer serialization -> CPU + KV thrash -> latency tail.
Jordan: mitigations we can try fast:
- revert kernel-binner weighting to previous default (rollback canary)
- re-enable preparse pool size (restore 03:04 config)
- enable writev coalescing in packetizer (software fallback)
- temporarily increase KV cache per-shard capacity by 20%
Kev: I can test writev coalescing patch on a local host in ~30m. It should cut syscall rate and coalesce small frames into 1-2 syscalls.
Max: I'll prepare a rollback PR for kernel-binner and a config flip for preparse pool.
Sara: Jordan, can you bump KV shard size via config toggle and watch eviction?
Jordan: on it, will flip in staging then on canary if green.
Kev: quick test (writev coalescing enabled locally): syscall rate down from 420/s -> 130/s, p95 down ~70ms in replay. Looks promising.
Sara: great. plan: rollback kernel-binner weighting immediately, revert preparse shrink, enable writev coalescing on canary, bump KV shards. If p95 recovers, we'll hold and then ship a nonbreaking kernel binner tune with microframe simulation.
Max: rollback PR merged and canary flip scheduled (deploy-bot will report).
deploy-bot: rolling back kernel-binner v2.1 -> previous config at 03:45 UTC
Jordan: KV shard bump toggled on canary at 03:47, eviction rate trending down already.
Kev: writev coalescing patch deployed to canary packetizer at 03:50 — early telemetry shows syscall rate normalized, tokenizer CPU trending down.
Sara: closing loop — p95 back to baseline within 5m of the full rollback+coalesce. Leaving this thread for postmortem writeup. Action items: Max -> postmortem + safe-kernel-tune checklist; Kev -> follow-up PR for packetizer coalescer tests; Jordan -> adjust KV shard autosizing heuristics to avoid thrash; Sara -> coordinate release window for re-probing kernel weights with microframe sim.
Max: noted. I'll draft postmortem and include replay scripts and perf artifacts.
Kev: will add microbench harness for writev coalescer and tokenizer pool contention tests.
Jordan: will add alert for sudden eviction rate >20% change within 1m.
Sara: thanks team. If anything else pops up, ping here. :thumbsup:
